hookText: POV: You caught the new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was just tending to the bed when someone caught me by surprise. The corridor was dark, and the only light came from my tallow candle. It flickered in the wind, casting shadows on the richly decorated walls.
caption:
